summary: Run the example with ansible-playbook -i inventory facts-demo.yml and expect a recap with ok and changed counts per device.
questions: How do I run the network facts demo playbook?

answer_card.title: Run the facts demo
answer_card.answer_md:
```console
ansible-playbook -i inventory facts-demo.yml
```
The recap should show each device with `ok=6` or `7`, `changed=2`, no failures.
